title: Planning-oriented Autonomous Driving
grouping: No containers; the four stages (Backbone, Perception, Prediction, Planning) are marked by thin bracket lines with centred labels along the bottom edge. A circled 'B' hub after the backbone branches up to the tracking module and down to the mapping module; the main line continues right through motion, occupancy and planner. A small legend (triangle and circle = ego-vehicle query, circled B = BEV feature) sits top-left.
shapes_depth: Modules are flat rounded rectangles, each with its own colour family used for fill, outline and label text: blue (tracking), purple (mapping), green (motion), yellow-olive (occupancy), red (planner). Each module's queries are a column of three squares shaded light to dark in the module colour. Inputs are a stack of camera-frame icons, the backbone a grey 3-D feature stack, the BEV feature a small oblique tile. A small render of each module's output (tracked cars on a road, a map segmentation, curved trajectories, an occupancy heat map, a 3-D road with the ego path) is perched above or below its box. Labels are serif; thin grey arrows carry 'K, V' labels.
proposed_highlight: Every task module is equal in weight but colour-coded; the planner, the goal of the chain, gets the strongest colour (red fill, red outline) at the far right, and the ego query glyph from the legend recurs at its input.
lesson: Give each task module its own colour family, tint its query squares in that colour, and perch a small render of the module's output (tracked boxes, map, trajectories, occupancy) right above or below its box, so the chain is read by its results.
notes: Venue CVPR 2023 from the arXiv comment 'CVPR 2023 award candidate' (venue_source: arxiv-journal-ref); year = that venue year (arXiv preprint 2022). The whole figure is a single raster image in the PDF (refs crop recorded one embedded image covering the crop), so kb measure cannot separate photos from drawing: photo_share is null and the palette includes the embedded photos and renders.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: end-to-end autonomous driving: tracking, mapping, motion, occupancy, planning

core.what: one left-to-right chain of task modules grouped by bracketed stage labels on a baseline rule (Backbone, Perception, Prediction, Planning), ending in a red Planner box at the far right

relations.form: multi-view camera frames -> backbone slabs -> BEV tile -> perception -> MotionFormer -> OccFormer -> Planner along one horizontal axis
a circled B BEV-feature node in the middle of Perception feeds TrackFormer above and MapFormer below, and the same B glyph recurs under OccFormer and Planner as their K,V input

each former receives a column of query squares from the side tinted in its own colour (track, map, motion, occ), and agent-level features from MotionFormer join OccFormer and Planner on a line beneath

a small rendered output sits on top of or under each module: tracked cars over TrackFormer, a map raster under MapFormer, trajectories over MotionFormer, occupancy grid over OccFormer, a planned path over Planner

channels.colour: colour = task: each module's pastel fill matches its query squares (blue track, purple map, green motion, gold occ), and the Planner is saturated red; the ego-vehicle query triangle/circle takes the colour of the module it belongs to
channels.shape: rounded boxes are modules, small squares are queries (shade = query slot), triangle and circle are the ego-vehicle query, circled B is BEV feature, slab stacks are the backbone
channels.line: thin solid arrows are data flow; K,V labels on arrows mark attention inputs
channels.frame: no frames; stages are marked by brackets on a baseline rule

quality.strengths: Stage brackets under one axis make the planning-oriented order readable at a glance; each module carries a small render of its output so the chain is read by its results; per-task colour is applied consistently to module fill and its queries; the shared BEV feature is one repeated glyph rather than long wires.
quality.weaknesses: Square shade inside each query column has no key; the agent-level/scene-level feature lines below OccFormer bend in long L-shapes to the planner; the Planner, the paper's goal, is no larger than the other formers.

insights.structure: Four stages run left to right as unframed columns, each named by a bracketed label on a baseline rule (Backbone, Perception, Prediction, Planning); Perception stacks TrackFormer above MapFormer around a central BEV node, and the rest is a single row MotionFormer -> OccFormer -> Planner.
insights.data: Multi-view input is a stack of camera-icon frames, BEV is a flat grid tile, queries are columns of shaded squares (blue track, purple map, green motion, gold occ) entering each former, and each module carries a small rendered output (tracked cars, map raster, trajectories, occupancy, planned path) sitting on top of its box.
insights.emphasis: Each module has its own pastel fill matching its query colour, ending in a saturated red Planner box; the circled B BEV-feature glyph recurs under every module to show what each one attends to.
insights.flow: One main horizontal axis through the B node carries the pipeline left to right; K,V arrows leave each former's output queries diagonally into the next stage, and a thin line from the ego query returns under OccFormer to the Planner.
insights.avoid: The rendered output thumbnails overlap the module boxes (the map raster sits on MapFormer), and the K,V arrows end in mid-air rather than at a target.

arrangement.units: four unframed columns marked only by bracketed stage labels on a bottom baseline (Backbone, Perception, Prediction, Planning)
arrangement.shared: the BEV feature B is redrawn as a circled glyph wherever a module consumes it
